verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a virtual mailbox service, so flagging or prioritizing government and legal mail is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents general envelope scanning, open-and-scan requests, forwarding, shredding and multi-user access. Nothing shows IRS, state-filing or service-of-process mail being identified, flagged, prioritized or alerted on.

support.subject: As an operator, government and legal mail — IRS, state filings, service of process — is flagged or prioritized so a compliance deadline never sits unread in the pile
